name: Birmingham
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Birmingham, MI: the Santa Walk, Santa House, Winter Markt and tree lighting in Shain Park, plus a Bloomfield Hills movie night.
lede: Birmingham celebrates Christmas in downtown and Shain Park, with a Santa Walk, a Santa House, a three day Winter Markt and a tree lighting where Santa arrives to light the city tree.
celebrates: Downtown Birmingham puts its holiday season in Shain Park. The Birmingham Santa Walk kicks things off on November 28, and the Winter Markt follows on December 4 to 6 with a tree lighting at 6 pm on opening night where Santa arrives. The Winter Markt adds a Santa House, a Kinderhaus children's area and free carriage rides, according to the Birmingham Shopping District. Bloomfield Hills, folded into this page, adds a holiday kids' movie night at The Kingsley hotel. Park at Henrietta and Martin Street to reach the market on foot.
lastyear: We did not find a host recap of the 2025 Winter Markt for this page, so this section does not describe one. What the Birmingham Shopping District's own listings show is that the Winter Markt is a returning event: its 2026 page presents the market as a December weekend in Shain Park, anchored by the tree lighting with Santa and the children's Kinderhaus, with free carriage rides, and a Santa House set up in the park ahead of opening night.
facts: The Birmingham tree is a 41 foot tree in Shain Park lit with more than 40,000 lights, according to the Birmingham Shopping District. The Winter Markt is presented by Mercedes-Benz of Bloomfield Hills. The Kinderhaus at the market is a dedicated children's area, and carriage rides are free. Shain Park sits at Henrietta and Martin Street in the center of downtown Birmingham.
traditions: A Saturday after Thanksgiving walk through downtown with Santa.
A little house in Shain Park where kids visit Santa.
A three day holiday market in Shain Park with a children's Kinderhaus and free carriage rides.
Santa arrives and the 41 foot tree is lit at 6 pm on the Winter Markt's opening night.
A holiday movie night for kids at The Kingsley in Bloomfield Hills.

faq: How does Birmingham, Michigan celebrate Christmas?

Downtown Birmingham gathers in Shain Park for the Santa Walk, the Santa House, the Winter Markt and a tree lighting with Santa. The market adds a children's Kinderhaus and free carriage rides. Nearby Bloomfield Hills adds a holiday movie night for kids at The Kingsley.
When is the Birmingham tree lighting?

The Winter Markt runs December 4 to 6, 2026, in Shain Park, and the tree lighting is at 6 pm on Friday, December 4, when Santa arrives, according to the Birmingham Shopping District. Plan to arrive before 6 pm because the park fills up for the ceremony, then stay for the Santa House and the Kinderhaus.
Is the Birmingham Winter Markt good for kids?

Yes. It has a Santa House, a Kinderhaus children's area and free carriage rides. It runs Friday December 4 from 4 to 9 pm, Saturday December 5 from 10 am to 9 pm and Sunday December 6 from 10 am to 4 pm.

Shain Park is in downtown Birmingham at Henrietta and Martin Street. The Winter Markt, the tree lighting and the Santa House all gather there, and the Birmingham Shopping District lists the park as the home of the market, so it is the place to start your visit.

trains: Amtrak's Wolverine route serves Royal Oak and Troy, the closest stations for Oakland County families. For a holiday train at a smaller scale, the Rochester Hills Museum at Van Hoosen Farm hosts the All Aboard model railroad exhibit, built by the Stoney Creek Model Railroad Club, on 13 dates from November 27 to December 30, 2026, with trains running noon to 3 pm.
